description: Figure 5 displays the distribution of deceived conversations as a percentage across five categories of ambiguity. The pie chart is divided into five slices, representing “Not Deceived,” “Partially Deceived,” “Deceived,” “Recruitment,” and “Academic Collaboration.” The slices are colored light blue, yellow, dark blue, light green, and dark green, respectively. The “Not Deceived” slice occupies approximately 31.6% of the chart, “Partially Deceived” occupies approximately 19.3%, “Deceived” occupies approximately 23.5%, “Recruitment” occupies approximately 13.9%, and “Academic Collaboration” occupies approximately 11.8%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered in a clockwise direction, starting with “Not Deceived” at the top and proceeding to “Academic Collaboration.” A legend is present, associating each color with its corresponding category.
